text: this menu [Image #11] can we move it here [Image #12] the place i circled. this panel i circled above the iso3d world editor, is fkn useless. and i want the full capability of editing the skin of a surface without needing to leave the route and the one over the map itself is getting crowded
resolution: Moved the iso build pane's face painter off the floating overlay that was crowding the map into a first-class PAINT tab in the top-right quadrant (the panel the user circled as useless). FacePainter now fills its pane (width/height 100%, material browser takes remaining height with its own scroll) instead of floating absolute; IsoAuthor drops the FacePainter mount and instead mirrors its selection up via a new onSelectionChange prop; the cart (index.tsx) holds isoSelectedIds and auto-opens the PAINT tab when a selection is gained, feeding FacePainter the build pieces + selection + commitBuildEvents. RightPanel gained the PAINT tab (Paintbrush icon, first in the rail). Full skin editing without leaving the route; map stays clear. Bundle-check passes. Fable 5 started this; finished by Opus 4.8 after the model handoff.
